criteria.statement: serializeVariantDetail groups variants into 128-variant NDJSON blocks in variantId order, one brotli member per block
build writes apps/backend/data/commanderSpellbookComboBlocks.br as the concatenation of the brotli block members
build writes apps/backend/data/commanderSpellbookComboIndex.json.br carrying a block directory (blocks: [{ offset, length }]) that correctly locates each block
--trim-committed re-blocks (filter survivors, re-serialize, rewrite) rather than splicing, and its test passes
brotli quality and size-hint params are fixed, named constants with no dictionary option
